categories.name: billing
categories.evidence: Layer 4 logs: 'Stripe not configured - billing features disabled'. GET /v1/billing/subscription with service-auth headers returns 422 (fail-closed). No Stripe secret or sandbox is configured in .env.
categories.risk: Paid launch cannot be claimed until Stripe/sandbox integration is validated with meter events, invoice aggregation, and idempotency checks.

categories.name: telemetry
categories.evidence: All L1-L6 /health and /ready return HTTP 200. L4/L5/L6 /metrics return Prometheus text from internal Docker gateway; L1 has no /metrics; L2/L3 return 503 'Metrics collection is disabled'. OpenTelemetry collector endpoint not configured locally.
categories.risk: Production must enforce METRICS_INTERNAL_SCRAPE_TOKEN and non-RFC1918 scrape networks; local staging accepts gateway IP as internal.

categories.name: alerting
categories.evidence: Alerting rules and alertmanager configs exist under monitoring/alerting/ and monitoring/alertmanager/. No Alertmanager or PagerDuty receiver is wired in docker-compose.live.yml.
categories.risk: Incident detection path cannot be validated locally; requires production observability stack and configured receivers.

categories.name: performance_slo
categories.evidence: Journey SLO scripts exist: apps/web/scripts/quality/collect-journey-slo-metrics.mjs and assert-journey-launch-slos.mjs. SLO data depends on a completed Playwright run; the P0 live journey suite is currently executing.
categories.risk: Launch SLOs cannot be confirmed until Playwright results are collected and thresholds are asserted.

categories.name: live_llm
categories.evidence: Provider-agnostic LLM adapters exist (services/layer4-agents/src/layer4_agents/services/llm_provider.py, together_provider.py, anthropic_provider.py). .env has LLM_PROVIDER=together but TOGETHER_API_KEY/LAYER4_TOGETHER_API_KEY are empty; no live calls were made.
categories.risk: Core GA cannot claim live LLM workflows are validated until provider credentials and grounded-citation/refusal/prompt-injection evidence are attached.

notes: Billing and live-LLM gates are intentionally fail-closed when provider credentials are absent; no auth bypass or unsafe fallback was introduced.
Telemetry is verified for local Docker reachability; production enforcement of scrape tokens and network policy remains a deployment concern.
Alerting and performance SLO evidence require the approved staging/production observability stack and a completed journey run.
